title: Compute chiral topological invariants
action: Implement the Green's functions for spinless and spinful chiral p-wave superfluids as described in the paper: for spinless use G^{-1}=i p0 + τ3(p^2/(2m)-μ) + c(τ1 p_x+τ2 p_y); for spinful use G^{-1}=i p0 + τ3(p^2/(2m)-μ) + c σ_z(τ1 p_x+τ2 p_y). Set m>0, c>0. For both μ>0 and μ<0, numerically integrate over (p_x, p_y, p_0) to compute the integer topological invariant N (the TKNN-type invariant from the Green's function). Write the four computed values into topological_invariants.json.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'N_spinless_mu_positive', 'N_spinless_mu_negative', 'N_spinful_mu_positive', 'N_spinful_mu_negative', each a float.

title: Compute planar phase invariants and spin Hall conductance
action: Implement the Green's function for the planar phase: G^{-1}=i p0 + τ3(p^2/(2m)-μ) + c τ1(σ_x p_x+σ_y p_y). Compute the symmetry-protected topological invariant N_K for μ>0 and μ<0 using the formula that includes the matrix K=τ3σ_z. Then compute the spin Hall conductance from the μ>0 value as σ_{xy}^{spin}=N_K/(4π). Write the N_K values and the conductance into planar_invariants.json.
description: Planar phase topological invariant and spin Hall conductance
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'N_K_mu_positive', 'N_K_mu_negative', 'spin_Hall_conductance', each a float.
